title: WP-08 closed at 12/12 with no conformance instrument whose subject is the daemon
body:
**FILED AS THE EXPLICIT ACCEPTANCE ARM OF cc's OWN HOLD ON `WP-08`, SO THE THING THE HOLD WAS PROTECTING OUTLIVES THE HOLD.** cc's board carried: *`WP-08` close -- RELEASED WHEN conformance coverage exists for the daemon, or the gap is explicitly accepted on the record.* vc ruled 2026-09-04 that 12/12 is the honest state of the contract and that the gap should be filed as its own item in the same motion as the close. **This issue IS that motion's second half. It is filed BEFORE the close, deliberately: closing first and filing second makes the protection depend on the next step being taken.**

## The gap

**`WP-08`'s twelve criteria are satisfied and NONE of them is a conformance suite against `intentd`.** The parity contract certifies the v3 CLI *by the incumbent* -- the v2 BATS estate runs against the v3 binary through an `INTENT_BIN` override, and v3 is green when v2's own suite cannot tell the difference. **The daemon has no equivalent instrument, because it has no v2 antecedent to be certified by.** `intentd` is new surface; the whole certification strategy is inapplicable to it by construction.

So the daemon's twelve satisfied rows rest on per-criterion tests written alongside the code they test, which is a materially weaker guarantee than the rest of the estate operates under, and **nothing in the register says so at the point where the guarantee is claimed.**

## What this is NOT

- **Not a claim that the twelve rows are dishonest.** They were driven and they are satisfied. `AC-08.9` in particular was checked at source on 2026-09-04 (`web.rs:77-79`, three routes) and is correct.
- **Not discharged by cc's `0216` integration harness.** That harness spins its own `RunningDaemon` and separates `0216` SILENTLY_LOST from `0226` REFUSED. It is one piece of daemon coverage and cc declined to argue it discharges the condition -- **a blocker that erodes because the blocked party built one piece of the thing is how conditions stop meaning anything.**

## What would discharge it

A conformance instrument whose subject is the DAEMON and whose pass condition is not written by the same hand as the code, in the way the v2 estate's is not. **The obvious candidate is the pair property the estate already relies on elsewhere: in-process and daemon must return identical results (`AC-08.2`, restated for the web face at `AC-08.9`).** That is differential rather than authored -- it compares two implementations rather than comparing one implementation to an assertion about it -- so it can fail without anyone having predicted the failure. `dual_path_conformance.rs` exists and is the place to look first; whether its population actually covers the daemon's surface is unmeasured and is the first thing to drive.

## Why it is filed rather than fixed

`v3.0.1` is feature complete under hv's standing ruling and there is no cut to be outside of, so this is not deferred for scarcity. It is filed because **a coverage gap is not a defect in the code and closing `WP-08` on 12/12 is the correct reading of its contract.** The gap is in what the contract asks for, and changing that is a criteria decision rather than a build.
